meta.title: Representative Species of Living Vascular Plant Families
meta.selectionPolicy: Curated representatives are preserved where available. Other families use the accepted Plantae species with the highest GBIF occurrence count within the matched family; an accepted-species search is used only when no occurrence facet is available. Two APG IV families whose GBIF Backbone placement uses broader historical family concepts are assigned named manual overrides with the discrepancy retained in the record.
